title: UI风格#9 - Neo-Brutalist (新粗野主义)
description: 创建第9种UI风格：新粗野主义风格 - 大字体、撞色、原始几何。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planI.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Neo-Brutalist style When color palette Then features bold contrasting colors: yellow, black, white, red
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: #FFFF00 yellow, #000000 black, #FFFFFF white, #FF0000 red high contrast palette

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Neo-Brutalist style When typography Then uses bold display fonts: Space Grotesk, Archivo Black, or Bebas Neue
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Archivo Black (display), Space Grotesk (headers), Inter (body)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Neo-Brutalist style When layout Then large type hierarchy, visible grid structure, raw borders, offset elements
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: visible 40px grid background, large type hierarchy, thick 4px borders, offset shadows

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Neo-Brutalist style When UI elements Then thick black borders, offset shadows, hard edges, no border-radius
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: 4px solid black borders, hard offset shadows (4px 4px 0 #000), zero border-radius, hard color inversions

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Neo-Brutalist UI When functional Then includes bold chat, raw borders, high-contrast agent cards
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: brutalist chat, unit cards with offset shadows, mission queue, DO IT/YELL/KILL buttons

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Neo-Brutalist UI When copy Then uses direct bold language: 'DO IT', 'BIG', 'RAW', 'BOLD', 'NOISE'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'DEFY. BREAK. BUILD.', buttons DO IT/YELL/KILL/WIPE, status DOING.../DONE./NOPE., UNIT/MISSION
